_about: Mirror of the HighLevel Developer Portal app configuration for the listing step. HighLevel has no file-based manifest — these are the exact values to enter in the portal (marketplace.gohighlevel.com -> My Apps -> Create App), prepared in advance. <APP_HOST> is wherever this wrapper is deployed over HTTPS.

app_setup.app_type_note: HighLevel's docs recommend starting Private for testing, then switching to Public. Private apps are capped at 5 agencies until published or past Security Review.
app_setup.listing_type_note: White-Label apps are visible on both HighLevel and white-label domains and must not reference HighLevel anywhere in the app or marketing — the listing name and copy in LISTING.md comply.

auth.client_keys: Generate in portal (Advanced Settings -> Auth -> Client Keys); copy the secret immediately — it is shown once. Put both values in the app environment (GHL_CLIENT_ID / GHL_CLIENT_SECRET).
auth.scopes_note: Minimum-necessary per HighLevel's own best practice: the v1 surface (a Custom Page bridged to Cynthia) calls no HighLevel data APIs. Phase 2 (answering inside Conversations) would add: conversations/message.readonly conversations/message.write
auth.shared_secret: Generate in portal (Advanced Settings -> Auth -> Shared Secret); put it in GHL_SHARED_SECRET. Never expose it client-side.

custom_pages.name: Cynthia
custom_pages.note: Served without X-Frame-Options and with CSP frame-ancestors for HighLevel domains; user context via the documented REQUEST_USER_DATA postMessage flow, decrypted server-side.

plans.name: Cynthia Starter
plans.price_note: Enter the contracted price from Planet Leads' existing white-label Starter band ($20-$100/mo per client) at listing. No new pricing is created by the app build.

pricing.revenue_share: HighLevel keeps 15%; seller keeps 85%. Agencies may re-bill sub-accounts at their own markup.

profile.tagline: The verified-answer AI for your clients — she only says what the business approved, verbatim.

before_submitting: App tested as Private in a real agency + location
Privacy policy and terms URLs live
Webhook URL reachable over HTTPS and INSTALL/UNINSTALL verified
Custom Page loads inside HighLevel with working user context
No reference to HighLevel anywhere in name, copy, or screenshots (White-Label rule)
review.expected_review_time: About 7-10 days (per HighLevel's docs for Marketplace submissions)
review.submit_from: Developer Portal -> app -> Basic Info -> Submit for Review

webhooks.events_note: INSTALL is subscribed by default when a webhook URL is set. Signature: Ed25519 in the X-GHL-Signature header, verified against HighLevel's published public key.
